cn.t: Critics are divided on this TV adaptation, with most finding it a sweet, good-natured crowd-pleaser that's heavy on innuendo and light on substance. Praised for witty songs and self-aware charm, but some dismiss it as saccharine and unnecessary.

vr.q: It remains a show that has absolutely stolen my heart and that I will easily recommend to many people.
